::: {.about-intro}
This blog sits at the intersection of analytics, software engineering, and applied problem solving.

Most posts start from practical work: building applications, improving developer workflows, exposing models through APIs, or making systems easier to maintain once they leave the prototype stage.
:::

## What you will find here

- R and Shiny workflows for production-minded projects
- APIs, package design, testing, and developer tooling
- MLOps patterns that are pragmatic rather than overbuilt
- Notes on software decisions, tradeoffs, and maintainability

## Why this site exists

Good technical work is often shaped by details that do not make it into polished demos: debugging, naming, structure, deployment constraints, and all the small choices that make a system easier or harder to evolve.

This site is where I write those things down.

## Direction

Over time, this page can expand with more personal background, current work, and selected projects. For now, the homepage is the best overview of the topics I write about.
